Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>', where LAST3 is
                the upper-cased first three letters of the last name and NNNN is a
                global 4-digit zero-padded sequence assigned at creation.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by every owner in the same household (same last
                name at the same address). Assigned when an owner is created with
                'sharesHousehold' true, and shared by all members of that household.
              type: string
              example: 'HH-3F2A1B0C9D8E'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners (as of this owner's creation) that share
                the same first name and last name, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object

2. **`OwnerMapper.java`** — added a MapStruct `@Mapping` for `membershipNumber` using an expression that calls a null-safe `membershipNumber(Owner)` helper, following the existing `displayName`/`initials` pattern. It computes `String.format("%s-M%02d", customerCode, registrationDate.getYear() % 100)`, returning `null` when either `customerCode` or `registrationDate` is absent (e.g. legacy seed owners), matching how those nullable fields already behave.

Since the value is derived from the owner's own persisted fields (`customerCode`, `registrationDate`), it appears consistently on both the POST-create response and GET responses without needing a separate `Assign` step or entity column.
